description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans placement filters based on silo metadata, including various grain classes with placement filter attributes and test cases verifying placement behavior with different silo metadata configurations.

classes.name: SiloMetadataPlacementFilterTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing Orleans silo metadata placement filters, including setup of test cluster and multiple test cases for placement behavior.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: Test fixture class that sets up an in-process Orleans test cluster with silo metadata configuration.

classes.name: UniqueRequiredMatchFilteredGrain
classes.description: Grain class with a placement filter requiring 'unique' silo metadata key, returning the hosting silo address.

classes.name: PreferredMatchFilteredGrain
classes.description: Grain class with a preferred placement filter requiring 'unique' silo metadata key, returning the hosting silo address.

classes.name: PreferredMatchMinTwoFilteredGrain
classes.description: Grain class with a preferred placement filter requiring 'unique' silo metadata key, with a minimum of two matches, returning the hosting silo address.

classes.name: PreferredMatchMultipleFilteredGrain
classes.description: Grain class with a placement filter requiring 'unique' and 'other' metadata keys, with a minimum of two matches, returning the hosting silo address.

classes.name: PreferredMatchNoMetadataFilteredGrain
classes.description: Grain class with a placement filter requiring 'not.there' key, which is not present, so it falls back to matching all silos, returning the hosting silo address.

methods.name: GetHostingSilo
methods.description: Method in each grain class that returns the address of the silo hosting the grain.
